craft_notes: Sthāyin: anti-Sāṃkhya verdict. Rows: hence-fits-not-but. Read aloud: dissent.

lines: Hence indeed the making is by this declared of it; Sāṃkhya's own
fits not — for selfhood's I-feeling he wishes not;
but we wish its making too.
l4.sanskrit_cite: ata eva kāra ity anena kṛtakatvam asya uktaṃ sāṃkhyasya tu tat na yujyate sa hi na ātmano 'haṃvimarśamayatām icchati vayaṃ tu kartṛtvam api tasya icchāmaḥ
